title: ShellFeature
description: Parametric Shell feature: hollows a solid to a constant wall thickness, optionally removing selected faces as openings. apply_to_mesh builds a basic mesh shell (vertex normal offset + connecting walls). Intended for manufacturing (plastic parts, thin walls, weight reduction).

thickness.description: Wall thickness: numeric value or parameter name / expression string. Positive.

faces.description: Optional list of face identifiers or mesh face indices to remove (openings). Empty or omitted means fully enclosed hollow or deferred selection.

direction.description: Thickness application direction. Inside keeps outer dimensions; outside grows the part; both adds material both ways.

operation.description: Intent: modify the current solid by shelling. Full offset/Boolean application deferred.
